subject: Math
prompt: A museum is giving away free passes every day. The equation $g(x) = 240 - 15x$ gives the number of free passes, $g(x)$, that remain to be given away after $x$ days. Which of the following is the best interpretation of $g(16) = 0$ in this context?

choices.A: The museum has $16$ free passes to give away.
choices.B: The museum will give away $16$ free passes in $15$ days.
choices.C: It will take $16$ days to give away all the free passes.
choices.D: It will take $240$ days to give away $16$ free passes.

explanation: Choice C is correct. The equation $g(x) = 240 - 15x$ represents the number of free passes remaining after $x$ days. In the expression $g(16) = 0$, the input value $16$ represents the number of days, and the output value $0$ represents the number of passes remaining. Therefore, $g(16) = 0$ means that after $16$ days, $0$ free passes remain to be given away. This is equivalent to saying it will take $16$ days to give away all the free passes.
